claim_text: Ordered this Acer monitor on a Friday and received it the following Tuesday. Item was intended as a birthday gift, so it was only opened about 2 weeks later. Upon unboxing, the screen was already cracked straight out of the box. This indicates the product was either damaged before delivery or insufficiently protected during shipping. Reached out to Acer Support and was told that cracked screens are not covered under warranty, regardless of condition upon first use. At the same time, Shopee declined any return or exchange as the return window had passed. This creates a complete gap in consumer protection. A defective product with zero accountability from both manufacturer and platform. Buyers take note: if you do not open and test immediately, you risk being stuck with a damaged item and no recourse. Extremely disappointing experience and not acceptable for a brand like Acer or a platform like Shopee

_dev.why: cracked LCD is plausible across both photos (no hard signal); the risky account on a high-value item raises it to Elevated for review
